title: Lawyer

steps: Litigation, a corporate law firm, in-house legal, or judiciary exams

rows.label: Top NLU → corporate law firm
rows.value: Strong starts (e.g., NLSIU median UG placement ~₹16 LPA)

rows.label: Litigation (court practice)
rows.value: Often low pay in the first years while you build a practice under a senior

rows.label: Judiciary
rows.value: Government pay scale + security after clearing judicial services exams

pros: Many paths: courts, firms, companies, policy, judiciary
Intellectually demanding; strong long-term earning potential
CLAT interest is growing fast (registrations up ~70% since 2023)
cons: Huge gap between top-NLU outcomes and everyone else
Early litigation years can be financially tough
Long hours at corporate firms; slow cases and paperwork in courts
AI is changing research and document review
sceneIdeas: Drafting a petition at midnight for a 10:30am listing
Your senior takes credit for your argument
A client wants you to bend the truth
Your case is adjourned for the fifth time
